title: OTP or PIN request
summary: Someone asks for a one-time code, PIN, or other authentication secret.
scenario: The requester says the code is needed to cancel, secure, or verify an activity.
warning_signs: A code arrives without an action you started
The requester wants the code read aloud or typed into a link
Threats that an account will close immediately
safe_actions: Do not disclose the code or PIN
Close the conversation and open the provider through a known route
recovery_guidance: Change affected credentials if they were shared
Contact the provider through an independently located channel
reporting_guidance: Preserve the message and time of the request
Report through a destination that has been checked independently
prevention_tips: Authentication codes are for your own sign-in flow
false_positive_notes: A code from a real service should still never require disclosure to another person.
